items.content_html: Sythoria is a lightweight, privacy-first AI chat application built with Next.js that connects to any OpenAI-compatible API provider (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Ollama). items.content_html: A lightweight JavaScript library for playing SVG animations in the browser. Pixodesk Animator runs animations created in the Pixodesk editor using the Web Animations API or requestAnimationFrame. It supports event triggers such as click, hover, and scroll. The library ships as ESM, CJS, and UMD bundles.
